title: mila quick notes and errands - daily scratchpad
content:
Quick brain dump / things to not forget

2026-03-12 (evening) - notes to self

MORNING PRIORITIES (first things)
- 09:00 sync with Sam: demo trimmed benchmark numbers (update slide 2) - 15m prep
- 09:45 ping infra about failing build on dedicated-cluster (CI logs show OOM) - create ticket if not present
- 10:30 run small throughput test against q4a-7b-qat and record p95 latency for 512 tokens; save outputs to /tmp/bench-q4a

WORK TODOS (short actionable)
- Fix flaky test embedding-runner/test_cache.py; try to reproduce locally with docker-compose up + increased log level
- Comment on rollout policy PR: ensure fallback ordering uses model-variant-v2 before v1-compat
- Update README snippet for model-pinning: example should show model: redwood/q4a-7b:2026-03-01
- Draft 3 bullets for product thread on cost-optimizations (for PM review)

PRIORITY MARKERS: red = blocking for tomorrow demo
- [ ] red: verify streaming response doesn't cut off after ~1024 tokens on staging (seen once)
- [ ] yellow: follow up with Rajiv on KV-cache memory tuning suggestions
- [ ] green: clean old notes in /tmp/scratch (delete files older than 7 days)

PERSONAL ERRANDS (fit between meetings)
- Drop off package at UPS before 17:00 Friday - label printed, take to main lobby dropbox
- Buy sharp cheddar for Friday team lunch
- Schedule dentist appointment - aim for 2026-04-05 morning; call on Wed to confirm
- Pick up dry cleaning (no later than Saturday)

IDEAS I DON'T WANT TO LOSE
- Add a tiny healthcheck endpoint that returns model-version and kv-cache-size to help SRE debugging
- Add a --dry-run flag to batching tool to estimate tokens and cost without sending traffic
- One-paragraph note about prefix-caching tradeoffs for product doc (low-latency vs memory)

NOTES FROM TODAY'S CALL (fragmented)
- Sam: saw ~8% perf delta between kernels on p4 vs a100 for long contexts; need more sample points
- Priya: customers asking for per-token debug logs; propose gated trace flag to control cost
- Ops: asked for a small telemetry field in responses identifying model variant and node id for tracing

MISC SHORT REMINDERS
- Move personal laptop to dedicated office shelf before EOD; include power brick
- Add sticky note on monitor: run benchmark before 14:00
- Check expense report for client dinner (Mar 6) - missing receipt?

END OF SCRATCHPAD - quick save. Will prune tomorrow morning and move persistent items to Confluence or Jira.
